top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Fall as Oil Extends Gains, Bonds Drop: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks declined as surging oil prices drove global bond yields higher and fueled concerns that resurgent inflation will force central banks to tighten monetary policy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Saudi Arabia Plans To Free 1 Mb/d As it Invests in Nuclear Power
top_signals.summary: Saudi Arabia’s power stations, desalination plants, factories and farms consume more than 1 million barrels per day of liquid fuel that the kingdom aims to displace by 2030. Natural gas and renewables will provide most of the replacement energy. Nuclear power could reduce domestic oil consumption further after 2030 as electricity demand continues to grow. top_signals.title: SEC proposes broad update to decades-old transfer agent rules with blockchain nod
top_signals.summary: The proposal would modernize rules largely unchanged since the 1980s, addressing blockchain-based recordkeeping, tokenized securities and increasingly automated market infrastructure.
